title: A steady simulation
label: 01 / Foundation
detail: Fixed-tick sessions keep rules independent of display refresh. Tick contexts, interpolation history, prepared schedules and checked resource access make updates explicit.
items: Scheduled and executed tick accounting
Pause, restart and single stepping
Typed resources and bounded task scopes

title: Worlds that respond
label: 02 / Physics
detail: Author 2D and 3D rigid bodies, compound assemblies, world-space joint frames and character movement. Checked mutations preserve the last valid world when inputs fail.
items: Atomic teleports and shape replacement
Sensor occupancy, impact reports and radial impulses
Character clearance and collision diagnostics

title: Two dimensions. One toolkit.
label: 03 / Rendering
detail: Build crisp 2D scenes or low-poly 3D worlds with procedural meshes, retained rendering, lighting, effects and checked material parameters.
items: Reusable geometry and retained mesh submission
Lighting, shadows and material reload tools
Visibility and rendering-capacity telemetry

title: Room for every control
label: 04 / Interface
detail: Measure text before painting it. Compose wrapped rows, readable stat lists, meters, content-driven cards and inspectors while sharing the geometry used to draw and interact.
items: Screen-space HUD reservations and checked canvas fitting
Atomic composition and UI semantic inspection
Paged Controls with complete current binding labels

title: Rules ready to compose
label: 05 / Gameplay
detail: Use explicit outcomes for input, inventory, crafting, objectives, progression, projectiles and rewards. Drive notices, score summaries and sounds from accepted events.
items: Tick-consumed action snapshots and edge-aware charges
Checked combo, shield and upgrade outcomes
Twelve-hole golf: one course, two playable views

title: Feedback with intent
label: 06 / Presentation
detail: Camera blends, cuts and rails, animation remapping, bounded accepted-event audio batches and independent motion and flash preferences help the action stay clear.
items: Live text-size and contrast preferences
Camera and animation inspection
Audio pause, recovery and voice admission

title: Authority you can follow
label: 07 / Networking
detail: Transport-independent server and prediction drivers accept supplied time. Bounded local datagrams, replication baselines and checked packet buffers expose outcomes rather than hiding backpressure.
items: Reliable send budgets and retained receive tails
Prediction history and clock diagnostics
Local browser peer sessions in Courtyard

title: Easy to find. Easy to verify.
label: 08 / Developer experience
detail: Keep the engine understandable for people and coding agents. Follow public symbols to source, run complete guide examples and inspect structured diagnostics without adding third-party engine dependencies.
items: Local API symbol search with provenance
Runnable guides, scaffolds and migration recipes
First-party Rust graph and reproducible browser manifests
